summary: The latest changes (OCR, date picker, and category management) did not introduce any new critical or high severity code issues. All existing high‑severity code findings remain addressed (data‑reset‑photo‑leak has been fixed). The open medium‑severity findings from the previous review (backup size DOS, passphrase brute‑force, CSV injection, passphrase length, photo path traversal) are unchanged. Deployment‑level dependency vulnerabilities (braces, node‑forge, sprintf‑js) still require remediation in the deployment environment.
